Package org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.integration.bitol.odcs

package org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.integration.bitol.odcs
Beans and enumerations for the Bitol Open Data Contract Standard (ODCS) v3.x (https://bitol-io.github.io/open-data-contract-standard/). DataContract is the root of the document.
  • Related Packages
    Package
    Description
    org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.integration.bitol
    Support for the Bitol open standards for data contracts and data products (https://github.com/bitol-io).
    org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.integration.bitol.common
    Beans and enumerations shared by the Bitol Open Data Contract Standard (ODCS) and Open Data Product Standard (ODPS), including the abstract BitolDocument root that Jackson uses to select the document type from the "kind" property.
    org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.integration.bitol.mapping
    Mappers that catalogue Bitol documents in open metadata (and, in later phases, generate them from open metadata).
    org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.integration.bitol.odps
    Beans and enumerations for the Bitol Open Data Product Standard (ODPS) v1.x (https://bitol-io.github.io/open-data-product-standard/).
  • Class
    Description
    DataContract
    This class represents an Open Data Contract Standard (ODCS) data contract as defined by the Bitol project (https://bitol-io.github.io/open-data-contract-standard/).
    DataContractEnumValue
    This class represents one allowed value in the enumeration of a schema property (ODCS v3.2.0, RFC 0033).
    DataContractLogicalType
    DataContractLogicalType lists the platform independent logical types of a schema property in an ODCS data contract.
    DataContractLogicalTypeOptions
    This class represents the options that refine the logical type of a schema property in an Open Data Contract Standard (ODCS) data contract.
    DataContractPricing
    This class represents the pricing information for the data described by an Open Data Contract Standard (ODCS) data contract.
    DataContractQualityDimension
    DataContractQualityDimension lists the data quality dimensions used in an ODCS data contract.
    DataContractQualityMetric
    DataContractQualityMetric lists the standard metrics evaluated by a library data quality check in an ODCS data contract.
    DataContractQualityRule
    This class represents a data quality check defined in an Open Data Contract Standard (ODCS) data contract.
    DataContractQualityType
    DataContractQualityType lists the types of data quality check in an ODCS data contract.
    DataContractRelationship
    This class represents a relationship (typically a foreign key) between schema elements in an Open Data Contract Standard (ODCS) data contract.
    DataContractRole
    This class represents an access (IAM) role that provides access to the data described by an Open Data Contract Standard (ODCS) data contract.
    DataContractSchemaElement
    This class represents the properties shared by the schema objects and schema properties of an Open Data Contract Standard (ODCS) data contract.
    DataContractSchemaMap
    This class describes the key and value of a schema property whose logical type is map (ODCS v3.2.0, RFC 0030).
    DataContractSchemaObject
    This class represents a schema object (typically a table, view, topic or file) in an Open Data Contract Standard (ODCS) data contract.
    DataContractSchemaProperty
    This class represents a property (typically a column or field) of a schema object in an Open Data Contract Standard (ODCS) data contract.
    DataContractServer
    This class represents a server (infrastructure location) where the data described by an Open Data Contract Standard (ODCS) data contract resides.
    DataContractServerType
    DataContractServerType lists the standard types of server (infrastructure) where the data described by an ODCS data contract may reside.
    DataContractSLADriver
    DataContractSLADriver lists the standard reasons (drivers) behind a service level agreement property in an ODCS data contract.
    DataContractSLAProperty
    This class represents a service level agreement (SLA) property of an Open Data Contract Standard (ODCS) data contract.
